profile.title: Faculty Profile — Juan Felipe Quintana Gómez
profile.roleLine: Senior Technical Consultant · Solution Architecture · Azure · .NET · Event-driven architectures · AI solutions · University professor
profile.acercaP1: I'm a Senior Technical Consultant and software professional with more than 15 years of experience designing and building solutions on Microsoft technologies, especially .NET and Azure. Throughout my career I've worked on enterprise projects as a senior developer, technical lead, and trusted advisor, contributing not only to implementation but also to solution design, architecture decisions, and technical mentoring.
profile.acercaP2: My experience includes designing scalable, maintainable architectures for integrations, backend systems, and distributed applications. I've worked with services and patterns such as Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Logic Apps, Cosmos DB, Hangfire, and microservices-based solutions. I currently help propose event-driven architectures to improve scalability, resilience, and decoupling in integration projects.
profile.acercaP3: Beyond my delivery responsibilities, I actively support my colleagues through technical mentoring, promoting best practices, architecture discussions, and solving complex problems. I enjoy helping teams grow in areas like clean architecture, SOLID principles, design patterns, and modern development practices.
profile.acercaP4: I've also contributed to defining architectures for AI-based solutions, exploring how to integrate AI capabilities into products and business processes in a practical, sustainable way aligned with value creation.
profile.acercaP5: My professional profile is strengthened by my academic experience as a professor at Universidad de Antioquia, where I help train future engineers and promote a structured approach to building high-quality systems.
profile.secCursos: Courses I teach at Universidad de Antioquia
profile.course1Desc: Design and analysis of advanced algorithms: computational complexity, recursion and iteration, data structures (stacks, queues, heaps), trees, graphs, dynamic programming, and NP-completeness. Builds analytical thinking and Python programming through collaborative work.
profile.course2Desc: Builds the skills to analyze and design reusable, maintainable software systems within a quality-oriented development process, promoting ethically responsible professional practice.
profile.course3Desc: Guides students through learning a programming language and its main paradigms, building the skills to solve real problems, with an emphasis on teamwork and good practices.
profile.course4Desc: Design and evaluation of software architectures: architectural patterns and styles (MVC, layers, microkernel, SOA, hexagonal, microservices), SOLID/DRY/KISS principles, UML modeling, web services, and cloud-native architectures (DDD, CQRS, API Gateway, Serverless), plus security across the software lifecycle.
profile.course5Desc: Quality assurance across the development lifecycle: international standards (ISO 9000, CMMI, ISO 25000, IEEE-730), quality metrics, unit testing, continuous integration, test plans and techniques, and automation frameworks.
